data.name: Free Spirit
data.description: Your strong belief in the value of freedom protects you from mental and physical shackles. +2 bonus on saves vs. mind-affecting and on escape attempts. Your strong belief in the value of freedom protects you from mental and physical shackles. You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws made against mind-affecting effects and on all Escape Artist or grapple checks made to escape a grapple or to escape from bonds.
